newsitem.title: USA: American Air labor talks to continue.
newsitem.headline: American Air labor talks to continue.

text.p: Talks between American Airlines and its pilots are expected to continue throughout the weekend, both sides said Friday after resuming contract talks for the first time in four weeks.
A spokesman for the Allied Pilots Association said "talks are expected to continue throughout the weekend at the discretion of Robert Harris."

Harris is the head of the Presidential Emergency Board (PEB) that the White House created on Feb. 15 shortly after the pilots went on strike to resolve the contract dispute between the nation's second largest airline and its 9,300 pilots. American is a unit of AMR Corp.
Harris is to submit the board's report to President Clinton on March 17.
APA president James Sovich said earlier in the week that the union and American would try to reach an agreement before the PEB submits its report to Clinton.
The talks could go into next week if the PEB opts to delay submitting its report to Clinton, the union said.
